title: Red Hat Security Advisory: bind security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: This Red Hat Security Advisory addresses multiple vulnerabilities in the Berkeley Internet Name Domain (BIND) 9 DNS software, including memory exhaustion, denial of service, DNSSEC validation bypass, cache poisoning, and arbitrary code execution. The advisory covers a range of CVEs affecting BIND 9 server and resolver components, with impacts such as denial of service via crafted DNS messages, resource exhaustion, and potential remote code execution. The update also includes a new root trust anchor key for DNSSEC. The advisory rates the security impact as Important and provides fixes for all listed issues.
